meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先调查并复现你报的 bug、收集证据,再判断缺陷归哪个仓库,产出英文 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可开 PR),含环境、复现步骤、根因与修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分诊 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 报告一个 LazyCodex 安装失败的 bug
say.note: 会先复现取证再建 issue

say.text: 把 Codex CLI 的沙箱 bug 提到 openai/codex
say.note: 判断归属后建 issue 或 PR

say.text: 帮我分诊这个 hook 的报错
say.note: 先搜重复 issue,有则补证据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude investigates your bug, reproduces it for evidence, decides which repo owns it, and writes one English GitHub issue (PR only for openai/codex) with environment, repro steps, root cause, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex install failure bug
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then files the issue

say_en.text: File the Codex CLI sandbox bug to openai/codex
say_en.note: Picks the repo, then issue or PR

say_en.text: Help me triage this hook error
say_en.note: Searches duplicates, adds evidence if found
